faq.heading: Image Watermark Remover FAQs
faq.intro: Answers about supported files, online use, pricing, sign-in, processing limits, and responsible use.

items.question: Is WatermarkGemini a free watermark remover?
items.answer: Yes. WatermarkGemini is completely free to use. There are no credits or paid packages. Google sign-in is required before processing.

items.question: What file types does the image watermark remover support?
items.answer: The homepage upload tool accepts one JPG/JPEG, PNG, or WEBP image up to 10 MB. Video, PDF, URL upload, batch processing, and other file types are not supported.

items.question: Can I use this online watermark remover without installing software?
items.answer: Yes. The upload, processing, comparison, and download workflow runs in your browser. You still need to sign in with Google before processing.

items.question: How do I remove watermark from image files on the homepage?
items.answer: Upload a supported image, sign in with Google, start processing, compare the original and returned result, and download the file when it is ready. The current interface does not include a manual selection brush.

items.question: Can I remove watermark from photo files?
items.answer: The homepage accepts supported photo files in JPG/JPEG, PNG, and WEBP format, up to 10 MB per file. Only one photo can be processed at a time.

items.question: Does the photo watermark remover support batch processing?
items.answer: No. The current homepage supports one image per processing flow.

items.question: Does WatermarkGemini support video watermark removal?
items.answer: No. The homepage tool is for supported image files only. It does not accept video or PDF files.

items.question: Can I use a watermark remover without losing quality?
items.answer: No watermark remover can guarantee identical quality in every case. Review the original and returned result side by side before downloading.

items.question: When is it appropriate to remove a watermark?
items.answer: Only process content you own or have permission to edit. Do not use the tool to misrepresent ownership or bypass another creator’s rights.
